text.p: Gap Inc. said Thursday it was recalling 10,000 stroller blankets it has sold in its babyGap and GapKids stores nationwide since November.

The blankets, made of 100 percent polyester fleece, have decorative stitching around the border, which can unravel, the company said. The recall was to avoid potential accidents or injuries from the unravelled string.
Customers are being offered a $50 gift certificate in exchange for the blankets, which originally retailed for $38.
The affected blankets come in two patterns: squares of alternating blue and green with a star in the lower right corner and squares of red and pink with a heart in the lower right corner.
A Gap spokeswoman said no injuries had been reported from the blankets.
